verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Trivy's scanning capabilities (vulnerabilities, secrets, IaC misconfigurations, SBOM) but contains no mention of baseline/ignore functionality (e.g., .trivyignore files, ignore-policy, or vex/exception handling) for suppressing known/false-positive findings so only new issues alert. missing for 10: any documentation of .trivyignore, VEX suppression, baseline scanning, or ignore-policy features, and any community/hands-on confirmation these work as expected.
